reader.requirement: At --std 85 a SAME RECORD AREA, SAME SORT AREA or SAME SORT-MERGE AREA clause whose files (sort-merge files and files of sequential, relative and indexed organization, with sequential, random or dynamic access) differ in organization or access must be accepted, with no check on organization or access, and the program must run.

edition-consulted.switches: Edition.Year < 2002 changes the report-file row of the occurrence table only (report file in SAME SORT AREA); the sort-merge and other-file rows, and every screen of the clause, are the same at 85 and 2023; no screen asks organization or access

reader.notes: SR6 is a permission; the SAME screens test membership counts, sort-merge presence and subset rules, never organization or access, so a mixed clause is accepted at 85. The record-area link (implicit redefinition) is made for any organization.
